label: Distinct cause of esse from an available external existence reason (inference)
rule: Apply the local PSR, select an external explanatory token, and apply the causal bridge to its bearer
meaning: For each contingent x at w the local PSR supplies a reason. Availability gives a reason for that same x whose source differs from x. BX2 applies to this selected token and identifies its source as a distinct CAUSE_2 of x's esse.
